read.en: Applied Materials jumped 11.4% on Nov 9 to $370.55, trading $342.98–375.52. It closed above the falling 5-day ($354.77) but below the falling 10-day ($377.20), 30-day ($436.32) and 100-day ($497.08) and the rising 200-day ($445.60). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($409.73), and RSI is 41.
read.zh: 应用材料 11月9日大涨 11.4%，收于 $370.55，盘中区间 $342.98–375.52。收盘站上下行的 5 日均线（$354.77），但仍位于下行的 10 日（$377.20）、30 日（$436.32）和 100 日均线（$497.08）以及上行的 200 日均线（$445.60）下方。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线下方且在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$409.73），RSI 为 41。

read.en: The rally broke the $350, $357 and $363 resistances (Nov 5–6 highs, 5-day, Nov 4 low), now support, and stalled under the 10-day. Resistance is $372.8–377.2 (Oct 23 low, Nov 9 high, 10-day), then $390–399 (Oct 30 close, Nov 2 high) and $409.7 (SAR). Support is $362.9, then $343–350 and $329.3. A close above $377.2 would target $390–399; below $362.9, $343–350.
